summary: Answer a legal question in a named jurisdiction, with binding and persuasive authority separated and every citation verified or flagged.

useCases.title: Research a legal question
useCases.message: Research this legal question in my jurisdiction. Start with secondary sources, then primary law, separate binding from persuasive authority, and flag anything you could not verify.

useCases.title: Understand the rules that apply to a client question
useCases.message: Research the legal or regulatory position behind this client question, and keep the sources and their authority clear.

useCases.title: Understand the rules before a decision
useCases.message: Research the legal position on this before I decide. Tell me which jurisdiction applies and what is settled versus contested.
